help:
NeoHaskell native installer

Install and update require a working multi-user Nix daemon. If cache settings are missing, review the proposed changes and authorize setup. For administrator-managed systems, see https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md

Usage:
  neo-installer [--help | --version]
  neo-installer install [--version VERSION]
  neo-installer update [--version VERSION | --rollback]
  neo-installer rollback

Install keeps an existing installation unless an exact version is requested. Update selects a verified stable release. Update --rollback and rollback restore the saved previous version of neo and neoctl.
Use --yes to accept the prepared installation review.
Use --plain for plain output or --still to disable animation. --yes always selects plain output and accepts the reviewed changes. Ctrl-Z and SIGTSTP cancel the operation and restore the terminal.
  neo-installer uninstall [--yes] [--plain|--still]
invalid_arguments: Unknown arguments. Run neo-installer --help for usage.
invalid_request: Use install or update with an optional --version VERSION, update --rollback, rollback, or uninstall.
command_path_conflict: An existing command blocks setup of {command} at {path}. The installer will not replace it. Identify how you installed that command and use that installation method to remove or relocate it before running this command again.
open_new_shell: Open a new shell to use neo and neoctl.
operation_failed: The requested operation did not complete. Keep the installation report and ask for help before changing installation files.
previous_missing: The saved previous version is missing files. Rollback cannot use it until those files are available again.
previous_unchecked: A previous version is saved for rollback. Its files have not been checked during this operation.
installed_lifecycle_help:
Update requires a working multi-user Nix daemon. If cache settings are missing, review the proposed changes and authorize setup. For administrator-managed systems, see https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md
  neo update [--version VERSION | --rollback]  Update or restore the installed neo and neoctl commands.
  neo rollback                                 Alias for neo update --rollback.

Rollback checks the saved version locally.
Use --yes to accept the prepared installation review.
Use --plain for plain output or --still to disable animation. --yes always selects plain output and accepts the reviewed changes. Ctrl-Z and SIGTSTP cancel the operation and restore the terminal.
  neo uninstall [--yes] [--plain|--still]
nix_cache_configuration: Cache setup could not finish. Ask your administrator to inspect any interrupted Nix configuration change and follow https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md before trying again.
nix_missing_client: The system Nix client is missing. Set up multi-user Nix before retrying. See https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md
nix_unproved_client: The installer could not verify the system Nix client. Check the Nix installation before retrying. See https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md
nix_daemon_unavailable: The system Nix daemon is unavailable to this account. Ask your administrator to check the daemon and your access. See https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md
nix_pair_acquisition: The Nix daemon could not obtain the required prebuilt packages. Check cache availability and configuration. See https://github.com/neohaskell/NeoHaskell/blob/main/neo/nix-setup.md
nix_daemon_mismatch: The local Nix daemon or system Nix client changed or returned an unexpected response. Check the running daemon before retrying.
operation_not_started: Cancelled before the requested changes began.
operation_stopped_no_pair: Cancelled. No managed NeoHaskell version is active.
cleanup_unknown: The installer could not confirm that its background work stopped. Keep the installation report and check for running installer processes before making further changes.
consent_required: The changes above need your approval. Run this command in a terminal to review and confirm them, or add --yes to accept them without a prompt.
review_declined: Cancelled. The changes shown in this review were not started.
shell_recovery_completed: Shell PATH recovery finished. Run the same command again to complete the requested installation or update.
shell_unsupported: Automatic shell setup supports /bin/bash and /bin/zsh. Your login shell is not supported. The requested installation could not continue.
shell_zdotdir_unsupported: Your shell uses ZDOTDIR to store its settings elsewhere. Automatic shell setup does not support this configuration. The requested installation could not continue.
shell_verification_failed: A fresh shell could not verify both managed commands and their versions. Shell startup or command precedence needs attention. Installation state has been retained for the next run.
review_shell_path: Add or check the NeoHaskell PATH entry in your shell settings. Keep existing commands ahead of this entry.
review_shell_startup: Run your shell startup files in new login and interactive shells to check neo and neoctl.
review_changed: Your installation changed after the review. The requested changes were not started. Run the command again to review the current installation.
recovery_unadmitted: Earlier recovery may still be pending. It was not changed by this request.
review_recovery: Finish the interrupted changes listed in this review.
review_command_directory: Create the command directory if it is missing.
review_command_links: Set up neo and neoctl to use the selected NeoHaskell version.
review_selection: Save the selected version for future updates and rollback.
review_retention: Keep the selected neo and neoctl packages available locally.
review_activation: Switch neo and neoctl together to the selected version if needed.
nix_policy_recovery_pending: An earlier installer left a Nix configuration change pending. Use the same earlier installer version to finish its recovery, then retry this version.
review_cleanup: Remove installation files that NeoHaskell no longer needs.
review_pending_recovery: An earlier operation was interrupted. This review includes the changes needed to finish it.

review_uninstall_changes: Remove the managed neo and neoctl commands, saved versions and NeoHaskell PATH entries. Keep Nix, your projects and unrelated files. Keep shell backups and installation locks. If removal is interrupted, run uninstall again to review what remains.
diagnostic_uninstall_cleanup_failed: The tools were removed, but retained diagnostic reports could not be cleared. Run uninstall again to retry report cleanup.
uninstall_complete: NeoHaskell commands, saved versions and managed PATH entries were removed. Nix and your projects were kept. Shell backups and installation locks remain.
uninstall_pending: Uninstall did not finish. Some installation files may remain. Keep the installation report and resolve the specific error below before running uninstall again.
bootstrap_report_unavailable: The installer download report could not be saved.
bootstrap_tools: The installer could not start because a required shell tool is missing. It needs curl, standard shell tools, and sha256sum or shasum. Check that these tools are available in PATH, then run the install command again.
bootstrap_platform: NeoHaskell cannot be installed on this system. This installer supports Apple Silicon macOS and Linux on x86-64 or ARM64. On Windows, use the PowerShell installer with WSL2.
bootstrap_staging: The installer could not create its temporary download files. Check free disk space and write access to TMPDIR, or /tmp when TMPDIR is not set. Installation has not started.
bootstrap_locator: The release information is invalid or belongs to a different release. Installation has not started. Get the install command from the NeoHaskell release page. If it still fails, share the download report.
bootstrap_download: The installer download failed. Installation has not started. Check your internet connection and access to GitHub, then try the install command again. If it still fails, share the download report.
bootstrap_integrity: The downloaded installer failed its size or checksum check, so it was not run. Get a fresh copy using the install command from the NeoHaskell release page. If it still fails, share the download report.
bootstrap_launch_failed: The verified installer could not run. Check the system error above and share the download report if you need help.
bootstrap_cleanup_failed: The temporary installer download files could not be removed. This does not change the installation result above. Check write access to TMPDIR, or /tmp when TMPDIR is not set.
bootstrap_preparing: Downloading the NeoHaskell installer and checking its checksum.
windows_start_failed: Windows could not start wsl.exe. Check your existing WSL installation.
windows_dispatch_failed: A command in WSL did not complete. Follow any installer guidance above. If no installer result appeared, open your selected WSL distribution and check that it starts normally.
windows_download_failed: The installer download failed. Installation has not started. Check your internet connection and access to GitHub, then run the command again.
windows_argument_invalid: Use -Version X.Y.Z to choose a version. Choose either -Plain or -Still for display options. Use -Yes to accept installation changes and -Distribution to choose a WSL2 distribution.
windows_wsl_missing: wsl.exe is unavailable. Set up an eligible WSL2 distribution before installing NeoHaskell.
windows_consent_required: Noninteractive installation requires -Yes. Use -Distribution to select an eligible WSL2 target if the configured default is unsuitable.
windows_target_invalid: The selected or default distribution is unsuitable. Use -Distribution with an existing WSL2 distribution running systemd on x86-64 or ARM64, with a non-root default Linux user, and a writable home.
windows_selected: NeoHaskell will be installed inside WSL distribution {0}. Use neo and neoctl from that WSL distribution.
windows_locator_invalid: The candidate locator is invalid or belongs to a different installer release.
windows_integrity_failed: The downloaded install script failed its size or checksum check, so it was not run. Get a fresh copy from the NeoHaskell release page. If it still fails, report the download failure.
windows_completed: NeoHaskell installation completed inside WSL distribution {0}. Use neo and neoctl from that WSL distribution.
windows_failure: The Windows installer stopped unexpectedly. Check whether the selected WSL distribution starts normally. If it does, report this failure before trying again.
windows_probe_limit: WSL inspection exceeded 30 seconds or 64 KiB. Check your WSL installation and retry.
windows_host_invalid: Use native Windows on x86-64 or ARM64 with an eligible WSL2 distribution.
windows_permissions: The selected Linux user needs a writable home and base64. Open this distribution to check those prerequisites before retrying.

errors.io: The installer could not read or write a required file. Check available disk space and your access to the installation directories. Keep the installation report if you need help.
errors.busy: Another NeoHaskell operation holds the installation lock. Wait for it to finish before running this command again.
errors.unsafe_path: The installer cannot safely use an installation path. A file type, owner, permission or link target did not meet its safety checks. Keep the installation report and inspect your HOME, XDG_STATE_HOME and ~/.local/bin settings before making changes. Do not run the installer with sudo to bypass this check.
errors.invalid_pair: The selected neo and neoctl packages do not form a valid matching installation. Keep the installation report and ask for help with this release.
errors.invalid_state: The saved installation record is inconsistent or unsupported. Keep the installation report and ask for help before editing or deleting installation files.
errors.command_link_conflict: An existing file or link conflicts with a managed NeoHaskell command. Check neo and neoctl in ~/.local/bin. The installer will not overwrite a command it does not own.
errors.foreign_active_target: The active NeoHaskell link does not match the saved installation record. Keep the installation report and ask for help before changing that link.
errors.no_installation: No managed NeoHaskell installation was found. Run the NeoHaskell installer to install neo and neoctl before updating or rolling back.
errors.no_previous_pair: No previous NeoHaskell version is recorded for rollback. Use neo update --version VERSION to choose a specific release.
errors.verification: The installer could not verify a download, saved package or installation file. Keep the installation report and check the release source before trying again. Do not bypass verification.
errors.activation_recovery: Restoring the previous active version also failed. The next message describes that recovery failure. Keep the installation report before making further changes.
errors.signal_cleanup: The installer could not restore its signal handlers. The operation result above still applies. Keep the installation report before starting another installer command.
